s.n: Boot camp crackers with pimento cheese
s.how: Grate 250g vintage cheddar finely. Mix with 120g mayonnaise, 80g chopped roasted red capsicum from a jar, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper and black pepper until well combined but still a little chunky. Chill for 30 minutes so the flavours settle. Spoon into a bowl, dust with a pinch of paprika and serve with 250g crackers and celery sticks.

Score 30 cocktail frankfurts diagonally a few times each. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan and fry the franks for 3 minutes until the cuts open up. Add 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp American mustard and 1 tbsp Worcestershire and toss for 2 minutes until sticky and glazed. Serve on toothpicks with a little pot of wholegrain mustard.

m.note: the drill sergeant they drive up the wall
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a lined loaf tin and spread with 4 tbsp tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Fry 2 sliced onions in 20g butter for 15 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 400ml beef stock and simmer to a gravy. Serve with 300g peas.

w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g caster sugar, 60g cocoa and 1 tsp bicarb. Whisk in 2 eggs, 250ml milk, 125ml oil and 250ml boiling water. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Cool. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 100g butter, then beat in 250g icing sugar and 4 tbsp milk until thick and glossy. Sandwich and cover the cakes with the icing and serve with whipped cream.

d.note: the armoured RV they borrow without asking
d.how: Brew 800ml strong coffee. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water, then tip it out. Stir 2 tsp brown sugar and 40ml Irish whiskey into each glass, then fill with hot coffee to 2cm from the top. Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream until it just thickens but still pours. Slowly pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Leave out the whiskey for anyone not drinking.
